conversation.subject: Your team's growth on Larkspur
conversation.body:
Hi Iris,

I noticed 52 people have been using Larkspur recently, which is more than the 40 seats on your plan, and a group of new people has joined. That is great to see. How are the plans for the team going, and would a short call to talk through the options be useful?

Aisha
